_comment: Ways of getting her attention, and how she takes it.
Every phrase must contain her name in some form - that is what keeps an
open microphone from answering the television. Spelling does not matter:
the matcher already knows Gladys, glad us, gladiss, glottis and the rest,
so write the name as 'glados' and say it however you like.
Filler words - please, just, now, uh - are ignored, so do not build a
phrase out of them: 'please glados' is heard as plain 'glados'.
mood decides which of her replies you get. Known moods: neutral, casual,
woken, morning, evening, checking, polite, curt. Anything else falls back
to neutral. Edit this file and she picks it up within a few seconds - no
restart, no retraining, no Colab notebook.
Deleting a line removes that way in. Adding one adds it.
